note: Wikimedia Commons, “Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 10081 Ефрем.png”; artist as recorded there: Unknown author — fetched 14 October 2026; the file is 576px wide. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Russian Menaion Reader plate «10081»: church-month 10 = June, day 8, this folder's Russian and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Ефрем»; the Russian Lives keep one Ephraim on 8 June, the patriarch of Antioch, which is this folder's Russian form «Ефрем Антиохийский». It is the only plate the series carries for that day. Commons describes it: Illustrations for the book: Lives of the Saints in Russian, presented according to the Chetyi-Minei manual with additions, explanatory notes and images of the saints.
